mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Reddan Soccer Park, and the Waxing Gibbous moon is out. Expect the overnight temperature to dip to 40 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is evaluating plans for an expanded Public Works and Utilities facility to improve efficiency and service. Meanwhile, construction continues on Mark Drive, Legion Street, and Country View Road to improve infrastructure throughout the city.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the Thursday night fun at the ART House. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable incident from November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance in the 100 block of West End Circle, resulting in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor is the delicious Double Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
